claim: Three Portuguese startups announced funding rounds between 23 October and 3 November 2026, as reported by Portugal Startup News.
Granter raised 1.6 million euros for its AI grant platform.
Intuitivo raised 1.35 million euros in seed funding.
Seamoretech raised 1.1 million euros in the first closing of its seed round.
Granter won the PITCH competition in November 2025.
Intuitivo was a PITCH winner in 2024.
Intuitivo was founded in Porto in 2021.
Seamoretech was founded in 2021 as a spin-off of the University of Porto's Faculty of Engineering (FEUP).
Seamoretech's total funding after the first seed closing is 3 million euros.
Granter's 1.6 million euro round was led by 3xP Global through its Impact Innovation Fund, under the Capitalization and Resilience Fund (FdCR) managed by Banco Português de Fomento.
